title: D-Day: Normandy landings
summary: On 6 June 1944 Allied forces landed in Normandy, France: American divisions at Utah and Omaha, British at Sword and Gold, Canadians at Juno. Nearly 160,000 troops landed that day, supported by over 7,000 naval vessels. The National WWII Museum counts over 10,300 Allied casualties and the White House fact sheet about 10,000. By the end of June over 850,000 troops had landed.

uncertainty.note: Day stated by both opened sources; the White House fact sheet says the assault began shortly after midnight.
